main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can keep cooking strong-smelling devil curry in the shared flat without its smell affecting others' rooms, laundry and work calls

A-B.evidence: A asks for no strong-smelling cooking (T1); B agrees (T2). Later A accepted weekends (T7) while B says weekends still smell (T8), though B's concerns are partly met by notice (T12-14).

A-C.evidence: C backs A's request (T3); A accepts weekend cooking (T7), but C says the day doesn't matter (T9) and rejects every D proposal through T36.

A-D.evidence: A asks for no such cooking (T1), D refuses (T4); A proposes weekends (T5), D says 'weekends work for me' (T6), A thanks (T7).

B-C.evidence: C says 'She's right' backing B's point (T9); B later accepts notice to shut the door (T12-14) while C keeps objecting about laundry and the fan cost (T15-36).

B-D.evidence: B objects to weekend smell (T8); D offers notice (T10); B asks for notice to shut the door (T12); D agrees (T13), B thanks (T14).

C-D.evidence: C rejects D's Sunday and check-in ideas (T17, T28); suggests a fan, D agrees to split it (T33), but C refuses to pay (T36).
